{"reason": "Added (high-confidence? edi-change) as a conjunct: 6/8 shown false rows (confidence 0.44–0.67) are low-confidence, so this prunes most false arbitrations (rate 0.714). v1 recall=1.0 gives slack above the 0.8 gate, and pct/exposure/frozen gates stay unchanged.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
